name: Kingdom of Egypt

flag.description: A green field with a white crescent, opening toward the fly, enclosing three white five-pointed stars.
flag.symbolism: The three stars are usually said to stand for Egypt, Nubia and Sudan; another reading links them to the country's Muslims, Christians and Jews.

hook: Royal Egypt's flag is green with a white crescent cradling three white stars; Pakistan has a single star and a white stripe at the hoist.
trivia: The green flag stayed in use after Egypt became a republic in 1953, until it joined Syria in the United Arab Republic in 1958.
Britain declared Egypt independent in 1922, and the sultan, Fuad I, took the title of king.
